convince.ask: 听录音，回答问题：说话人想说服朋友什么？
convince.listen: I want to convince my friend to join us.
convince.why: convince my friend to join us 说服朋友加入我们。

convince.stem: The story ______ me that he was right.
convince.why: 故事发生在过去，用过去式 convinced。

convince.ask: 从 convince、persuade 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
convince.stem: She ______ me to go with her yesterday.
convince.why: persuade sb. to do 劝某人去做；convince 多指让人相信。

convince.ask: 用所给单词的适当形式填空。
convince.why: be 后面用形容词 convincing（有说服力的）。

convince.ask: 句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
convince.stem: He convinces me that he was right last night.
convince.why: last night 是过去时间，动词用过去式。

convince.ask: 根据中文完成句子，每空一词。
convince.zh: 他的话使我确信他是对的。
convince.stem: His words ______ me that he was right.
convince.why: 过去的事用过去式 convinced。

convince.stem: I am ______ that he will come.
convince.why: be convinced that 确信，用过去分词作表语。

sauce.ask: 听录音，回答问题：说话人想要什么？
sauce.listen: I want some tomato sauce on my chips.

sauce.stem: Would you like some ______ on your salad?
sauce.why: 拌沙拉的调味汁用 dressing，不用 sauce。

sauce.ask: 从 sauce、paste 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
sauce.stem: Please add some tomato ______ to the soup.
sauce.why: 稠的番茄膏用 paste；sauce 是浇的汁。

sauce.ask: 用所给单词的适当形式填空。
sauce.stem: There are three different ______ on the table. (sauce)

sauce.ask: 句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
sauce.stem: I like to put some sauces on my fish.
sauce.why: sauce 作不可数用，这里用原形。

sauce.ask: 根据中文完成句子，每空一词。

sauce.stem: The cook made a special ______ for the meat.
sauce.why: a special 后面接单数名词 sauce。

salad.ask: 听录音，回答问题：说话人午饭吃什么？
salad.listen: I had a green salad for lunch today.

salad.why: a 后面接单数名词 salad。

salad.ask: 从 salad、sauce 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
salad.stem: She put some dressing on her ______.
salad.why: dressing 是拌色拉用的，所以填 salad。

salad.ask: 用所给单词的适当形式填空。
salad.stem: We ordered two ______ for the table. (salad)

salad.ask: 句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
salad.stem: There are many salad on the menu.
salad.why: many 后面接可数名词复数 salads。

salad.ask: 根据中文完成句子，每空一词。
salad.why: have salad for lunch 午饭吃色拉。

salad.stem: These ______ days were the best time of his life.
salad.why: salad days 固定短语，用单数 salad。

salary.ask: 听录音，回答问题：说话人说什么涨了？
salary.listen: His salary went up last month.

salary.stem: He earns a good ______ every month.
salary.why: a good 后面接单数名词 salary。

salary.ask: 从 salary、pay 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
salary.stem: The workers get their ______ every Friday.
salary.why: 统称工资用 pay；salary 是按月发的固定薪水。

salary.ask: 用所给单词的适当形式填空。
salary.stem: The company pays different ______ to its workers. (salary)
salary.why: different 后面用复数 salaries，y 变 i 加 es。

salary.ask: 句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
salary.stem: She gets a good salarys every year.
salary.why: a good 后面接单数 salary。

salary.ask: 根据中文完成句子，每空一词。
salary.stem: His ______ is paid on the fifth of each month.
salary.why: 按月发的固定薪水用 salary。

salary.stem: My ______ is higher than his, but his job is harder.
salary.why: my 后面接单数名词 salary。

salsa.ask: 听录音，回答问题：说话人喜欢跳什么舞？
salsa.listen: My sister loves dancing salsa very much.

salsa.stem: We need some ______ for the chips, a spicy tomato sauce.
salsa.why: salsa 指拉美风味辣酱；sauce 是一般的酱汁。

salsa.ask: 从 salsa、sauce 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
salsa.stem: This dance comes from Latin America and is called ______.
salsa.why: 这种拉美舞叫 salsa；sauce 是酱汁。

salsa.ask: 用所给单词的适当形式填空。
salsa.stem: They are learning two ______ this term. (salsa)
salsa.why: two 后面用复数 salsas（指两种萨尔萨舞曲）。

salsa.ask: 句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
salsa.stem: I like to eat chips with tomato salsa, it is a kind of dance.
salsa.why: tomato sauce 番茄酱；salsa 是舞或辣酱，这里说吃的酱用 sauce。

salsa.ask: 根据中文完成句子，每空一词。
salsa.zh: 我姐姐每周都跳萨尔萨舞。

salsa.stem: There are many kinds of ______ in the Latin dance class.
salsa.why: many kinds of 后面用复数 salsas。

dust.ask: 听录音，回答问题：说话人说什么东西到处都是？
dust.listen: There is dust all over the old books.

dust.stem: The old table is covered with ______.
dust.why: dust 不可数，没有复数，也不加 a。

dust.ask: 从 dust、dirt 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
dust.stem: Please clean the ______ off the windows; it's grey and dry.
dust.why: 窗户上灰蒙蒙的干灰用 dust；dirt 偏污垢。

dust.ask: 用所给单词的适当形式填空。
dust.stem: After the storm, the road was very ______. (dust)
dust.why: be 后面用形容词 dusty（满是灰尘的）。

dust.ask: 句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
dust.stem: She dusted the cake with sugar yesterday.
dust.why: dust 作“撒”讲，过去式 dusted 正确。

dust.ask: 根据中文完成句子，每空一词。
dust.zh: 他每天打扫书架上的灰尘。
dust.stem: He cleans the ______ off the bookshelf every day.
dust.why: 灰尘用不可数名词 dust。

dust.stem: The farmer ______ the crops with powder last week.
dust.why: last week 用过去式 dusted。

dusty.ask: 听录音，回答问题：说话人觉得那本书怎么样？
dusty.listen: The old book on the shelf is very dusty.

dusty.stem: This room is ______ than that one.
dusty.why: than 前面用比较级 dustier（y 变 i）。

dusty.ask: 从 dusty、powdery 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
dusty.stem: The road was ______ after the trucks passed.
dusty.why: 路上落满灰用 dusty；powdery 指粉末状的。

dusty.ask: 用所给单词的适当形式填空。
dusty.stem: There is a lot of ______ on the desk. (dusty)
dusty.why: a lot of 后面接名词 dust（灰尘）。

dusty.ask: 句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
dusty.stem: My shoes are the dusty in the room.
dusty.why: the 后面表示“最脏的”要用最高级 dustiest。

dusty.ask: 根据中文完成句子，每空一词。
dusty.zh: 这间屋子比那间更满是灰尘。
dusty.stem: This room is ______ than that one.

dusty.why: 名词前作定语用形容词 dusty。

duster.ask: 听录音，回答问题：说话人用什么擦桌子？
duster.listen: Please use a duster to clean the desk.

duster.stem: There are two ______ on the shelf.

duster.ask: 从 duster、rag 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
duster.stem: She wiped the window with a wet ______.
duster.why: 湿抹布用 rag；duster 多指掸子。

duster.ask: 用所给单词的适当形式填空。
duster.stem: He cleaned the desk with a ______. (duster)
duster.why: a 后面接单数名词 duster。

duster.ask: 句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
duster.stem: I need two duster to clean the room.
duster.why: two 后面名词要用复数 dusters。

duster.ask: 根据中文完成句子，每空一词。
duster.zh: 请用掸子把书架上的灰去掉。
duster.stem: Please use a ______ to clean the shelf.
A duster is a tool for ______ dust.
duster.why: 介词 for 后面用动名词 removing。

virtual.ask: 听录音，回答问题：说话人说的会议是什么形式？
virtual.listen: Our class had a virtual meeting online yesterday.

virtual.stem: The ______ ruler had all the power in the country.
virtual.why: 名词前作定语用形容词 virtual（实际上的）。

virtual.ask: 从 virtual、effective 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
virtual.stem: He is the ______ leader, though he has no title.
virtual.why: 没有名分但实际掌权用 virtual；effective 强调有效。

virtual.ask: 用所给单词的适当形式填空。
virtual.why: 句首修饰全句用副词 Virtually（几乎）。

virtual.ask: 句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
virtual.stem: We had a virtual meet online last week.
virtual.why: a 后面要用名词 meeting。

virtual.ask: 根据中文完成句子，每空一词。

virtual.stem: The school uses ______ classrooms to teach online.
virtual.why: 名词前作定语用形容词 virtual。

virtually.ask: 听录音，回答问题：说话人说的这座城市怎么样？
virtually.listen: This city is virtually the same as my hometown.
virtually.why: virtually 意思是“几乎、差不多”。

virtually.stem: The two pictures are ______ the same. I can't tell them apart.
virtually.why: 修饰 the same 表示“几乎”用 virtually。

virtually.ask: 从 virtually、almost 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
virtually.stem: The work is ______ finished, so we can go home now.
virtually.why: almost 不能直接修饰 the same 这类词，此处用 almost 更自然；virtually 也可，但本题考常用搭配。

virtually.ask: 用所给单词的适当形式填空。
virtually.stem: We had a ______ meeting last week. (virtually)
virtually.why: 修饰名词 meeting 要用形容词 virtual（线上的）。

virtually.ask: 句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
virtually.stem: He virtually finished the work, but he still had one page to do.
virtually.why: 句意是“几乎完成但还差一页”，用 almost 更准确；virtually 强调“实际上差不多”。

virtually.ask: 根据中文完成句子，每空一词。
virtually.stem: He gets up early ______ every day.
Her ______ is known to all her friends.
virtually.why: 物主代词后接名词，此处指“美德”用 virtue。

virtue.ask: 听录音，回答问题：说话人认为诚实是什么？

virtue.stem: Patience is one of his best ______.
virtue.why: one of 后面接可数名词复数 virtues。

virtue.ask: 从 virtue、merit 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
virtue.stem: She got the prize by ______ of her hard work.
virtue.why: by virtue of 是固定短语，意为“凭借、由于”。

virtue.ask: 用所给单词的适当形式填空。
virtue.stem: Kindness is a ______ that everyone should have. (virtue)
virtue.why: a 后面接单数名词 virtue。

virtue.ask: 句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
virtue.stem: He was praised for his many virtue.
virtue.why: many 后面接可数名词复数 virtues。

virtue.ask: 根据中文完成句子，每空一词。
virtue.zh: 他凭借自己的努力获得了成功。
virtue.stem: He succeeded by ______ of his hard work.
virtue.why: by virtue of 意为“凭借、由于”。
主语是复数，表语用复数 virtues。

chicken.ask: 听录音，回答问题：说话人晚饭想吃什么？
chicken.listen: I'd like some chicken for dinner.

chicken.stem: There are many ______ on the farm.
chicken.why: 可数的“鸡”用复数 chickens；chicken 指鸡肉时不可数。

chicken.ask: 从 chicken、hen 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
chicken.stem: The farmer keeps a lot of ______ for eggs.
chicken.why: 下蛋的是母鸡 hen；chicken 是统称。

chicken.ask: 用所给单词的适当形式填空。
chicken.stem: Look! A little ______ is following its mother. (chicken)

chicken.ask: 句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
chicken.stem: I bought two chicken and some rice for lunch.
chicken.why: 两只鸡是可数的，用 chickens。

chicken.ask: 根据中文完成句子，每空一词。
chicken.why: chicken out 意为“临阵退缩”。
指鸡肉时 chicken 不可数，不加 a 也不加 s。

chick.ask: 听录音，回答问题：说话人看到了什么？
chick.listen: Look, the little chick is yellow.

chick.stem: The ______ are playing in the garden.
chick.why: 主语是复数，chick 的复数是 chicks。

chick.ask: 从 chick、chicken 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
chick.stem: Look at that ______ over there. It is very small.
chick.why: 指小鸡用 chick；chicken 多指鸡或鸡肉。

chick.ask: 用所给单词的适当形式填空。
chick.stem: Two ______ came out of the eggs. (chick)

chick.ask: 句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
chick.stem: The chick is very small and cute.
chick.why: 句子正确，chick 单数作主语，is 搭配。

chick.ask: 根据中文完成句子，每空一词。

chick.stem: There are five ______ on the farm.

edge.ask: 听录音，回答问题：说话人站在哪里？
edge.listen: Don't stand near the edge of the cliff.

edge.stem: Be careful! The knife has a sharp ______.

edge.ask: 从 edge、border 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
edge.stem: The river is the ______ between the two countries.
edge.why: 两国之间的边界用 border。

edge.ask: 用所给单词的适当形式填空。
edge.stem: He ______ slowly along the wall yesterday. (edge)

edge.ask: 句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
edge.stem: She is edging careful along the narrow bridge.
edge.why: 修饰动词 edging 用副词 carefully。

edge.ask: 根据中文完成句子，每空一词。
edge.zh: 他紧张不安地等着结果。
edge.stem: He was on ______ while waiting for the result.
edge.why: on edge 表示紧张不安。

edge.stem: The ______ of the table is very sharp.

double-edged.ask: 听录音，回答问题：说话人怎么形容这把剑？
double-edged.listen: This sword is double-edged and very dangerous.

double-edged.stem: A ______ sword can cut both ways.

double-edged.ask: 从 double-edged、edged 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
double-edged.stem: The knife is ______, so be careful.

double-edged.ask: 用所给单词的适当形式填空。
句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
根据中文完成句子，每空一词。

buzzer.ask: 听录音，回答问题：说话人说什么响了？
buzzer.listen: The buzzer rang, so I opened the door.

buzzer.stem: Please press the ______ to call the nurse.
buzzer.why: 按蜂鸣器叫人用 buzzer；bell 是叮铃的铃。

buzzer.ask: 从 buzzer、bell 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
buzzer.stem: The school ______ rings at eight every morning.
buzzer.why: 学校“叮铃”的铃是 bell，不是 buzzer。

buzzer.ask: 用所给单词的适当形式填空。
buzzer.stem: There are two ______ on the wall. (buzzer)

buzzer.ask: 句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
buzzer.stem: The buzzer ring loudly and everyone heard it.
buzzer.why: and 后 heard 是过去式，前面也用过去式 rang。

buzzer.ask: 根据中文完成句子，每空一词。
buzzer.stem: The ______ at the door is broken.
buzzer.why: 门口“嗡嗡”响的装置是 buzzer。

buzzer.stem: The ______ went off and we all left the building.
buzzer.why: 火警警报用 alarm，不是蜂鸣器。

victor.ask: 听录音，回答问题：说话人说的是谁？
victor.listen: The victor raised the cup and smiled.

victor.stem: The ______ of the race got a gold medal.
victor.why: 赛跑获胜者用 victor 或 winner；这里考 victor 拼写。

victor.ask: 从 victor、conqueror 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
victor.stem: The ______ took the city and ruled it for years.
victor.why: 带“征服、占领”意味用 conqueror。

victor.ask: 用所给单词的适当形式填空。
victor.stem: The two ______ shook hands after the game. (victor)

victor.ask: 句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
victor.stem: The victor were very happy after the match.
victor.why: the victor 是单数，be 动词用 was。

victor.ask: 根据中文完成句子，每空一词。
victor.zh: 他是这场比赛的胜利者。
victor.stem: He is the ______ of this match.
Every ______ in the game gets a small prize.
victor.why: 一般的“获胜者”用 winner；victor 偏书面。

victory.ask: 听录音，回答问题：说话人说的是什么？
victory.listen: Our team won a great victory yesterday.

victory.stem: The players celebrated their ______ after the final match.
victory.why: their 后面接名词，指这一场胜利用 victory。

victory.ask: 从 victory、win 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
victory.stem: It was a great ______ for the whole team.
victory.why: a great victory 是固定搭配，强调胜利这一结果。

victory.ask: 用所给单词的适当形式填空。
victory.stem: The team has won many ______ this year. (victory)
victory.why: many 后接复数，y 变 i 加 es。

victory.ask: 句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
victory.stem: Our class had a great victorious in the game.
victory.why: had 后面要名词 victory，不能作形容词。

victory.ask: 根据中文完成句子，每空一词。
victory.why: this 后接单数名词 victory。

victory.stem: The ______ army marched into the city.
victory.why: 修饰名词 army 要用形容词 victorious。

victorious.ask: 听录音，回答问题：说话人怎么形容这支队伍？
victorious.listen: The victorious team came home with the cup.

victorious.stem: After the game, the ______ players ran to their fans.
victorious.why: 修饰 players 要用形容词 victorious。

victorious.ask: 从 victorious、winning 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
victorious.stem: The ______ team held up the cup.
victorious.why: 描写打赢了的队伍用 victorious。

victorious.ask: 用所给单词的适当形式填空。
victorious.stem: Our team was ______ in the final match. (victory)
victorious.why: be 后面要形容词 victorious。

victorious.ask: 句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
victorious.stem: The victory team smiled at the camera.
victorious.why: 修饰名词 team 要用形容词 victorious。

victorious.ask: 根据中文完成句子，每空一词。
victorious.zh: 获胜的队员们大声欢呼。
victorious.why: 修饰 players 用形容词 victorious。

victorious.stem: They sang songs of ______ after the match.

eviction.ask: 听录音，回答问题：说话人说的驱逐发生在哪里？
eviction.listen: The eviction of the family from their home made everyone sad.

eviction.stem: The landlord began the ______ of the tenants last week.
eviction.why: the … of 中间要名词 eviction（驱逐）。

eviction.ask: 用所给单词的适当形式填空。
eviction.stem: There were three ______ in this building last year. (eviction)

eviction.ask: 从 eviction、evict 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
eviction.stem: The court decided to ______ the family from the flat.
eviction.why: decide to do 后面用动词 evict。

eviction.ask: 句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
eviction.stem: The eviction of the old man were very sad.
eviction.why: 主语 eviction 是单数，be 动词用 was。

eviction.ask: 根据中文完成句子，每空一词。
eviction.zh: 这家人的驱逐让邻居们很难过。
eviction.stem: The ______ of the family made the neighbours sad.
eviction.why: the … of 结构用名词 eviction。

eviction.stem: They faced ______ from their home last winter.
eviction.why: face 后面接名词 eviction 作宾语。

convict.ask: 听录音，回答问题：法庭判了那个人什么罪？
convict.listen: The court convicted him of stealing money.
convict.why: convict sb of sth 判某人有某罪。

convict.stem: The judge ______ him of robbery last month.
convict.why: last month 用过去式 convicted。

convict.ask: 从 convict、sentence 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
convict.stem: The court will ______ him of murder next week.
convict.why: convict sb of sth 定罪；sentence 是判刑。

convict.ask: 用所给单词的适当形式填空。
convict.stem: His ______ came as a shock to the whole town. (convict)
convict.why: his 后面要名词 conviction（定罪）。

convict.ask: 句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
convict.stem: The man was convicted for stealing a car.
convict.why: be convicted of 是固定搭配。

convict.ask: 根据中文完成句子，每空一词。
convict.stem: The court ______ him of the crime.
The ______ was sent to prison for ten years.
convict.why: 作主语指囚犯用名词 convict。

conviction.ask: 听录音，回答问题：说话人对自己的信念感觉如何？
conviction.listen: She spoke with great conviction about her plan.

conviction.stem: He has a strong ______ that hard work brings success.
conviction.why: a strong … that 从句用名词 conviction（信念）。

conviction.ask: 从 conviction、belief 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
conviction.stem: She spoke with deep ______ about the future.
conviction.why: with conviction 坚定地；belief 不用于此搭配。

conviction.ask: 用所给单词的适当形式填空。
conviction.stem: Her ______ about the plan never changed. (conviction)
conviction.why: 主语复数意义，用复数 convictions。

conviction.ask: 句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
conviction.stem: He was a man of strong beliefs, and nothing could shake his conviction.
conviction.why: a man of strong belief 是固定说法，指有坚定信念的人。

conviction.ask: 根据中文完成句子，每空一词。
conviction.zh: 她带着坚定的信念说话。

conviction.stem: The ______ of the thief took two years.
conviction.why: the … of 结构用名词 conviction（定罪）。
